messages:
kara: publish pipeline red on sdk-utils v3.4.0 -> failing regendiff on sample-apps after typegen bump. blocking the release train.

ben: which bump? semver-wise is this patch or minor?

mohit: looks like an auth/retry shape change leaked into generated clients. some optional fields moved under `auth.meta` which changed ordering and a few field names. regen diffs are non-trivial.

kara: CI excerpt: 
```
- client.options.retryPolicy: { backoff: "exp", jitter: true }
+ client.options.auth.meta.retryPolicy: { backoff: "exp", jitter: true }
```

jen: oof. consumers that do shallow compares and samplekit tests assume old shape. this is observable. IMO minor.

ben: were there changelog entries in typegen release? I can't find any in the tag.

ci-bot: pipeline #5124 failed: regendiff-check (logs: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/5124)

publish-bot: suggested temporary mitigation: pin sdk-utils to typegen@2.3.1 in workspace.lock to bypass regen checks.

mohit: pinning will buy time. propose two parallel actions: (1) revert generator change in a patch to restore compatibility quickly, (2) follow up with a minor that documents auth shape change + migration guide for SDKs and sample apps.

devrel: please also add a short devex onboarding note for sample app maintainers: always run `yarn regen-check` before bump approvals and add expected regen-note in release PR.

kara: I'll open a revert PR for the gen change and a pin PR in sdk-utils. adding a changelog entry is required for any generator-output change per new checklist; we didn't have one here.

ben: also add a golden test for SDK that does deep-equality on generated client schema to catch these. and add a lint rule to require CHANGELOG entry in release PR templates when typegen changes version.

ci-bot: pipeline #5125 started (after pin/revert).

ci-bot: pipeline #5125 failed: missing changelog check in release PRs. see https://ci.redwood/checks/5125 for details.

mohit: okay small gap: the release automation expects a `REGEN_NOTE.md` file in the release PR when generator output may change. we'll add that to the template and to devex docs.

jen: can we add a short snippet to the onboarding guide that shows how to pin in `package.json` and how to opt into the new auth shape via `--experimental-auth-meta` flag during regen? will help sample app owners.

kara: created PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/901 (revert-auth-meta), https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-utils/pull/678 (pin-typegen). kicking CI.

ci-bot: pipeline #5126 started.

ci-bot: pipeline #5126 passed  regendiff-check skipped for pinned dependency.

ben: follow-ups: update release playbook (link: https://docs.redwood/release-playbook) to include: changelog required, regen_note required, devex pointer for sample apps, and semver policy clause for generator-output changes.

mohit: I'll draft the devex doc "Generator output changes: semver & onboarding guidance" and add examples for auth/retry migration, pinning, and `--experimental` opt-ins.

devrel: thanks, leaving notes here for traceability and will circulate a short email to the SDK maintainers. :email:
